title: Apple Centauri Hardware Security Engine (btse / SARA) Specification

security_engine_architecture.engine_name: SARA (Security Accelerator Register Architecture) Hardware Crypto Core

primary_mmio_blocks.description: Crypto domain power-gating and clock management

SARA_CMD.description: Command and execution trigger register (START, RESET, FLUSH)

SARA_STATUS.description: Engine status register (BUSY, DONE, ERROR, KEY_VALID)

firmware_assertion_guards.description: Crypto dispatched while SARA busy flag asserted
Hardware parity or authentication error interrupt
State restore failed during sleep exit

firmware_assertion_guards.symbol: Failed to allocate AES handle, instance=%d

key_storage_and_vault.vault_type: Hardware-isolated on-chip secure register file; plaintext keys are write-only and physically unreadable by Cortex-M firmware

slot_allocation.purpose: Authenticated encryption for paired Bluetooth BR/EDR and BLE ACL connections ('acl_generate_link_key', Assert ID 337)
Resolvable Private Address (RPA) hardware hash validation ('IRK list reached out of bounds', Assert ID 175)
Pseudo-random sounding tag descriptor and frequency hop pattern generation ('BLE_CONNECTION_TRANS_CS_SECURITY')
Co-processor secure token generation for UWB ranging unlock ('connected.open.pending.range_setup.uwb_get_key')

aes_ccm_engine.standard: NIST SP 800-38C & Bluetooth Core Spec Part B Section 6.5
aes_ccm_engine.counter_mode: 39-bit packet counter with 1-bit direction flag to prevent replay attacks
aes_ccm_engine.zero_payload_guard: LE encryption payload is all zeros (Assert ID 143)

stages.name: FETCH_VALIDATE_BEGIN
stages.description: Host transfers wrapped ECDH P-256 public key and pairing challenge to Centauri mailbox

stages.name: PUBLIC_KEY_VALIDATION
stages.description: Hardware SARA engine validates point is on NIST P-256 curve (y^2 = x^3 - 3x + b mod p)

stages.name: DIFFIE_HELLMAN_CALCULATION
stages.description: Hardware elliptic curve scalar multiplication yields shared secret Z

stages.name: FETCH_VALIDATE_DONE
stages.description: Derived LTK loaded directly into allocated SARA hardware key slot; returns confirmation token to Host

failure_handling.action: Immediate tear-down of BLE connection, flush of key slot, and transmission of LMP_NOT_ACCEPTED error PDU
